plugins.name: agentdash
plugins.description: Multi-host agent progress dashboard: session-native hooks fold conversation events into a task DAG with verification-gate states; works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, opencode and ZCode against one shared .agentdash contract (host-attributed events); zero runtime, hooks call the `agentdash` binary on PATH. Terminal panel / character DAG / vector svg / oneline statusline / interactive watch TUI.
